Detailed Description

A single processing block delay.

You need to insert one of these wherever there is a feedback loop in a UGen graph (usually via a Plug).

BlockDelay::BlockDelay ( UGen const &  input  )  throw ()

Base BlockDelay Constuctor, use the AR() and KR() versions in user code.

Generic UGen argument documentation: Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions). Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being created is made multichannel via other arguments. Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)
